transcript.text: lg w/d keeps saying dE n wont start?? door is shut

The 'DE' code on LG appliances typically indicates a Door Error. First, please try waiting 5 minutes with the power still on; if a cycle just finished, the lock may simply be releasing. If nothing happens after 5 minutes, switch the machine off at the wall socket, wait another 5 minutes to reset the electronics, and then try opening the door again. If it remains locked or won't start even when unlocked, please let me know if you see a small padlock icon on the display (which would indicate Child Lock is active) or if there are any clothes caught in the rubber seal.
tried turning it off n on, still dE. theres a corner of the duvet squashed in the rubber seal tho, its a king size one stuffed in. didnt see a padlock

That trapped duvet corner is very likely the cause: if the catch can't engage properly because of the fabric, the door lock won't confirm it's shut and the machine will refuse to start. Please switch the machine off at the wall socket first for safety. Gently pull the duvet out from the seal so the door closes fully, then close it firmly until you hear a click. Does the 'DE' code clear or does it stay on?
[Panel: "To check a suitable replacement — Enter your model number below. Once we have the model I can check whether a suitable replacement is available. It's usually on a sticker inside the door or around the frame, or on the back of the appliance."]
ok pulled the corner out n shut it firmly, it closes but springs back a bit. still got the duvet bulging against the glass tho

The 'DE' code means the machine doesn't think the door is securely locked. Because the duvet is still bulging against the glass and the door is springing back, it likely isn't engaging the latch properly even after you pulled the corner out. Before we look at parts, please try this: switch the machine off at the wall again. Open the door fully and redistribute the duvet so it's not bunched up against the edge. Close the door firmly by hand until you hear a distinct 'click'. Then turn the power back on and press Start. If it still shows DE, we'll need to check if the lock itself is working. Could you tell me the model number (usually found on a sticker inside the door rim or on the back of the machine)?
[Panel: "To check a suitable replacement — Enter your model number below. Once we have the model I can check whether a suitable replacement is available. It's usually on a sticker inside the door or around the frame, or on the back of the appliance."]
model is FWV796WTSE, its on the label. its a king size duvet tho, do i need to take some out? mums visitors coming soon

Yes, a king-size duvet is very heavy and will bunch up on one side, which stops the machine from locking or spinning. Please switch it off at the wall again, open the door, take the duvet out completely, fold it in half to balance it, put it back in evenly around the drum, close the door firmly until you hear a click, turn the power back on and try starting it.
ok will try folding it n putting it back evenly. if it still says dE after that what do i do?
Sometimes the latch mechanism gets stuck and needs to be 'woken up'. Does the code clear after doing this?
wait what do u mean wake up the latch?? i havent done the fold thing yet, what exactly do i do

Sorry for the confusion—there is no 'waking up' trick, just a physical fix. Please switch the machine off at the wall first. Open the door and take the duvet out completely. Fold it in half to balance it, then put it back in evenly around the drum so it isn't bunched on one side. Close the door firmly until you hear a click, turn the power back on, and try starting it.
ok got it, will fold it n put it back evenly then try. what if it still says dE after?

If the 'DE' code stays on after balancing the duvet properly, it usually means the machine still isn't detecting that the door is securely locked. This could be because the latch mechanism is physically worn or the electronic door lock (interlock) has failed. If you try the balanced load fix and it still shows DE, we will need to look at testing or replacing the door lock assembly.
